-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

`say` performs `Console`, which its annotation does not list.
The annotation for `say` lists `IO`, which its body does not perform.

1| say : String ->{IO} ()
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

2| say text = print text
              ^^^^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    String ->{IO} ()

but the body needs:

    String ->{Console} ()
